nodes.name: Google Drive — New Cover Upload
nodes.notes: Polls the BookLeaf uploads folder every minute. Triggers on new file creation. File must follow naming: ISBN_bookname.pdf or ISBN_bookname.png

nodes.name: Validate Filename & Extract ISBN
nodes.notes: Validates the ISBN_bookname.ext filename format. Extracts ISBN. Throws error if invalid — stops the workflow.

nodes.name: Download Cover File from Drive
nodes.notes: Downloads the actual file bytes from Google Drive using the file ID. Returns binary data.

nodes.name: CoverGuard Vision Engine — Analyze
nodes.notes: Calls the FastAPI Vision Engine on Render. Sends the cover file for analysis. Returns: {status, confidence, violations, annotated_image_path, ...}

nodes.name: PASS or REVIEW NEEDED?
nodes.notes: Routes the workflow: PASS → update Airtable as PASS + send congrats email. REVIEW NEEDED → upload annotated image + flag in Airtable + send correction email.

value.Correction Instructions: No corrections needed. Cover is approved.

nodes.name: Airtable — Create PASS Record
nodes.notes: Creates a PASS record in Airtable with all required fields.

parameters.subject: Your Cover Has Passed Quality Check | BookLeaf Publishing
parameters.message:
={{ $json.passEmailHtml || '

Hi Author,

Your cover has passed all quality checks! Congratulations.

- BookLeaf Publishing QA Team

' }}

nodes.name: Send PASS Email to Author
nodes.notes: Sends the congratulatory PASS email to the author. Author email is looked up from Airtable Authors table by ISBN.

nodes.name: Prepare REVIEW Data
nodes.notes: Prepares metadata for the REVIEW NEEDED branch: extracts violations, correction text, annotated image path.

nodes.name: Airtable — Create REVIEW Record
nodes.notes: Creates a REVIEW NEEDED record in Airtable with all violation details and correction instructions.

parameters.subject: Action Required: Cover Revision Needed | BookLeaf Publishing
parameters.message:
={{ $json.reviewEmailHtml || '

Hi Author,

Your cover requires revision. Please check the attached annotated image for details.

- BookLeaf Publishing QA Team

' }}

nodes.name: Send REVIEW Email to Author
nodes.notes: Sends the REVIEW NEEDED email with specific correction instructions and annotated image attachment.
